title: Report: Keenan Allen's BAC was measured at 0.224 percent

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Keenan Allen's BAC was measured at 0.224 percent
sources.description: Colts receiver Keenan Allen faces an enhanced misdemeanor charge for DUI, because his blood-alcohol concentration (alcohol concentration equivalent, in Indiana parlance) exceeded 0.15 percent after he was arrested last month.
